device_entry.name: Prior弧光灯快门
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: 用于控制Prior弧光灯照明光路的快门，在显微和光学实验中实现照明的开启、关闭与状态查询，以便允许或阻断光线照射样品。
device_entry.description_en: A shutter used to control the illumination path of a Prior arc lamp. In microscopy and optical experiments, it is used to enable or block lamp light and to query the shutter state.

schema.description: 查询弧光灯快门是否处于开启状态。

schema.description_en: Open the arc lamp shutter to allow illumination to pass.

schema.description: 关闭弧光灯快门，阻断照明光。
schema.description_en: Close the arc lamp shutter to block illumination.
